name: f1-manager-light
description: Historical Formula 1 management game built with React, Vite and a JSON-backed simulation database.

scripts.check: npm run test:career && npm run test:entities && npm run test:drivers && npm run test:driver-integration && npm run test:simulation && npm run test:management && npm run test:manager && npm run test:management-events && npm run test:management-depth && npm run test:development && npm run test:development-regulations && npm run test:technical-department && npm run test:ai-technical && npm run test:technology-adoption && npm run test:ai-technical-soak && npm run test:save-safety && npm run test:race-entry && npm run test:race-weekend && npm run test:race-strategy && npm run test:live-race && npm run test:track-layout && npm run test:race-control && npm run test:weekend-weather && npm run test:injuries && npm run test:health && npm run test:replacements && npm run test:ai-reserves && npm run test:negotiations && npm run test:roles && npm run test:opening-state && npm run test:season-packs && npm run validate:data && npm run build
scripts.season:generate: npm run build:data && node scripts/build-team-seasons.mjs && node scripts/build-driver-history.mjs && node scripts/build-season-packs.mjs && node scripts/build-historical-assets.mjs
scripts.season:generate:test-years: npm run build:data && node scripts/build-team-seasons.mjs && node scripts/build-driver-history.mjs && node scripts/build-season-packs.mjs --years=1975,1980,1981,1982,1983,1984,1985,1987,1989,1999,2014,2020 && node scripts/build-historical-assets.mjs

scripts.test:technical-department: node --test tests/technicalDepartment.test.js tests/playerTechnicalLifecycle.test.js tests/nextSeasonCar.test.js tests/nextSeasonRegulations.test.js tests/technicalKnowledge.test.js tests/nextSeasonTechnicalPackage.test.js tests/technicalStrategy.test.js tests/nextSeasonMaterialization.test.js
